questions.phrase: Infers that X on the grounds that Y

options.text: Conclusion: X and Y, no Evidence

questions.explanation: 'On the grounds that' points backward to evidence, so Y is the evidence and X is the conclusion.

questions.phrase: Concludes X on the basis of Y
questions.explanation: 'On the basis of' points backward to evidence. Y is the evidence; X is the conclusion.

questions.phrase: Concludes, from the claim that X, that Y
questions.explanation: 'From' points backward. X is the evidence (the starting claim). Y is the conclusion drawn from it.
'To support' points forward to the conclusion. X is the evidence; Y is the conclusion.

questions.phrase: Takes for granted that Y because X
questions.explanation: 'Because' points backward to evidence. X is the evidence; Y is the conclusion.

questions.phrase: Argues for X by appealing to Y
questions.explanation: 'By appealing to' points backward to evidence. Y is the evidence; X is the conclusion.

questions.phrase: Cites X in order to establish Y
questions.explanation: 'In order to establish' points forward to the conclusion. X is the evidence; Y is the conclusion.
'Follows from' points backward to evidence. X is the evidence; Y is the conclusion.

questions.phrase: Bonus: Infers Y given that X
questions.explanation: 'Given that' points backward to evidence. X is the evidence; Y is the conclusion.
